name: polynomial chaos expansion
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 用正交多项式展开随机响应的表示方法。
usage_overview: 用于建立随机输入与结构响应之间的近似关系，通过正交随机多项式及确定性系数构建概率分析代理模型，支持性能函数统计矩的计算和结构可靠度的近似评估，包括抗连续倒塌可靠性分析。

complete_examples.text: Reliability Progressive collapse Polynomial chaos expansion Moment method Frame structures A B S T R A C T New reliability computation framework is proposed based on polynomial chaos expansion method and used to investigate the reliability of four typical configurations of reinforced concrete (RC) frame structures under progressive collapse.
An alternative approach is to use the polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) [38], which is derived based on a set of orthogonal stochastic polynomials.
